title: AZ-900 · Describe cost management in Azure · Describe the Microsoft Cost Management tool

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe cost management in Azure
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the Microsoft Cost Management tool
questions.question: Which statement best describes Microsoft Cost Management?

options.text: A set of tools for analyzing, monitoring, and managing Azure costs
Actions that can be triggered when a spending threshold is reached, such as shutting down nonproduction resources
Ongoing cleanup and management that prevents unused associated resources from continuing to incur cost
The amount of a resource used during a billing period

questions.explanation: Microsoft Cost Management is a set of tools for analyzing, monitoring, and managing Azure costs.

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe cost management in Azure
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the Microsoft Cost Management tool
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Cost analysis refer to?

options.text: Metadata such as Prod, Dev, or Test used to classify deployment environments
A source of third-party solutions that can add vendor charges to Azure service costs
A name-value metadata pair attached to an Azure resource
A Cost Management feature for visualizing and grouping spend by dimensions such as subscription, resource group, region, or service

questions.explanation: Cost analysis is a Cost Management feature for visualizing and grouping spend by dimensions such as subscription, resource group, region, or service.

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe cost management in Azure
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the Microsoft Cost Management tool
questions.question: Which description correctly matches Budget alert?

options.text: Tags do not automatically inherit from subscriptions or resource groups to child resources
A notification generated when spending reaches or exceeds a defined budget threshold
Modeling storage type, access tier, and redundancy choices to see how they affect estimated cost
Using metadata to mark resources according to classifications such as public or confidential

questions.explanation: Budget alert is a notification generated when spending reaches or exceeds a defined budget threshold.
